Source: We approached this chapter by providing frameworks for understanding the migration process, posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD), and mental health and wellbeing of migrants with special focus on migrants of African origin.

Source: The Migration Theory of Boswell (Addressing the causes of migratory and refugee movements: The role of the European Union (Working Paper No. 73). United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees, Geneva. https://www.unhcr.org/3e19ac624.pdf, 2002) was critiqued and principally utilized to explain the root and proximate causes, enabling conditions and sustaining factors of migration with backgrounds in the existing macro, meso and micro theories of migration.

Omukungu w’ekitongole kya United Nations High Commission for Refugees, Geneva. https://www.unhcr.org/3e19ac624.pdf, 2002) yakolokotebwa era n’akozesebwa okunnyonnyola ensibuko y’okusenguka, embeera ezisobozesa n’ebintu ebiwanirira okusenguka okusinziira ku nnyinyonnyolero z’okusenguka eziriwo.

Kọmíṣọ́nà àgbà ti United Nations fún Àwọn tí Wọ́n ń Gbé Ìlú Láìsí Ìwé Ìgbélùú, Geneva. https://www.unhcr.org/3e19ac624.pdf, 2002) ṣe ìgbéléwọ̀n àti àmúlò rẹ láti ṣe àlàyé ìpìnlẹ̀ àti ìdí pàtó, àwọn ipò tí ó lè gbà wáyé àti àwọn okùnfà tí ó fẹsẹ̀ múlẹ̀ lórí ìṣíkúrò àwọn èèyàn láti ìlú kan sí ìlú míràn pẹ̀lú ìpìnlẹ̀ nínú èrò ńlá, èrò tó tóbi díẹ̀, sí èrò tó kéré jù lọ lórí ìṣíkúrò.
